steps.name: gemini-backend
steps.summary: Text agent on Vertex AI by default: src/lib/agent/model.ts textClientOptions()/textGenAI() (GEMINI_TEXT_BACKEND=vertex|api, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GEMINI_VERTEX_LOCATION=global, ADC, no key; one shared client); voice stays on the Gemini API key (ephemeral tokens). HTTP 402 logs 'gemini billing error (402)' and maps to UPSTREAM in model.ts and live.ts (voice keeps its existing message 'Voice is not available right now. Please type instead.'). Deep health (src/lib/health.ts, deps api/text/liveTokens) now returns checks store, textModel, liveModel (model lookups on the API key: Vertex models.get gives 403), textGenerate (1 token via text backend), keyGenerate (1 token on the API key; added because authTokens.create still succeeds with 402 credits, measured), liveToken. Local probe: 503 with only keyGenerate failing. eval-agent records backend; eval on Vertex 32/32 (evals/results/2026-10-13T04-56), p90 21.2 s (I-105). deploy.sh sets GEMINI_TEXT_BACKEND=vertex. Docs: ARCHITECTURE, ADR-011, SECURITY, OPERATIONS, TESTING, README; ISSUE I-104 (P0 upstream-billing, open until the AI Studio credits are topped up) and I-105. Not deployed.

steps.name: domain-model
steps.summary: Types (src/types/menu.ts): KioskDomain food|ticket, KioskData.domain, locales: Locale[] (schema default ["ko"]), optional dineOptions, optional vocabulary {item, add, cart} (KioskVocabulary); MenuItem.kcal number|null, optional subtitle; priceDelta may be negative. kioskSchema in catalog.ts matches; new allKioskIds() and vocabularyOf(k) (food default 메뉴/menu, 담기/Add, 장바구니/Cart). malo.json has domain food (locales default ["ko"], step 2 sets ["ko","en"]); learnedToKiosk sets domain food, locales [skill.locale] (kcal still 0, logged I-106). machine.ts: setDineOption → BAD_REQUEST without dineOptions (direct and learned), requestCheckout asks for a dine option only when the kiosk has dineOptions, offerChoices refuses dine choices there. UI call sites type-check with optional dineOptions (K2 Dine returns null, others optional chaining); no MALO change. Tests first: catalog.test.ts runs generic checks (unique ids, names, images, groups, brand words incl. rail/pizza brands, prices multiple of 10, lowest resolvable fare >= 0, domain/locales) for every allKioskIds() kiosk plus schema tests for a ticket-shaped kiosk; machine.test no-dine kiosk; cart.test negative delta. ARCHITECTURE menu schema and setDineOption/requestCheckout rows updated (R-002). lint, build, 594 unit, e2e 7 passed/5 skipped; evidence/*.json restored after e2e (I-099).

steps.name: airport-rail-data
steps.summary: data/kiosks/airport_rail.json: kioskId airport_rail, direct, domain ticket, brand 스카이라인 공항열차 / SKYLINE AIRPORT RAIL (not 공항철도: real operator name, on the step-1 brand list, I-107), tagline 도심까지 가장 빠른 길; navy theme primary #163A70, dark #0C2449, tint #DCEBF9, accent #F6C445 (ink text), bg #F6F8FB, all pairs >= 9:1; locales [ko,en], no dineOptions, vocabulary 승차권/ticket, 선택/Select, 선택한 승차권/Selected tickets; upsellRules [] (transit card needs a top-up choice, so a one-tap upsell would hit NEEDS_CHOICE). Categories express, all_stop, pass; 11 items, variant single only: express_city_center 11,000 (best, seat group window/aisle optional), express_city_center_return 21,000, all_stop_{harbor_gate 1450, expo_park 2050, riverside 3150, old_town 4150, city_center 4750} with subtitles, day_pass 15,000, two_day_pass 25,000, transit_card 4,000 + required top_up (top_up_0/10000/20000/30000, no default), rail_night_bus_combo 18,000 soldOut. Every train: required passenger group adult(0)/teen(-20%)/child(-50%)/senior(-30%), default adult; kcal null, allergens [], availableHours null. Stroke SVG pictograms (24 grid, 1.75 stroke, navy) in public/kiosks/airport_rail/{train,express,ticket,card,pass}.svg; kioskSchema imagePath now /menu/ or /kiosks/ (ARCHITECTURE updated). Registered in catalog.ts sources (KioskId, allKioskIds = malo, doughhouse, airport_rail), so /kiosk?k=airport_rail already loads before step 3 generalizes the UI; kiosk tiles may need unoptimized/plain img for SVG. Tests: airport_rail block in catalog.test.ts (categories, passenger default, fares >= 0, card top-up, theme contrast, no real names, no emoji) and cart.test.ts (transit_card NEEDS_CHOICE top_up, 2 adult + 1 child express = 27,500, card + 10,000 = 14,000); fixed step-1 -0 bug in the generic delta check (I-108). lint, build, 614 unit tests pass.

steps.name: kiosk-generalize
steps.summary: One set of kiosk components driven by data. kioskScreen(session, local, kiosk) skips K2 when the kiosk has no dineOptions. KioskScreen holds the K1 language (한국어/English buttons for kiosk.locales, keyed by session so a new session resets to kiosk.locale) and passes children a kiosk copy with that locale, so every screen still reads kiosk.locale; root gets lang. src/lib/i18n/kiosk.ts: KIOSK_TEXT exported (comingSoon/langKo/langEn removed), TICKET_TEXT overrides for domain ticket (구매하기/Buy, 승차권 수/Tickets, 매진, 참조 번호/Reference number, 승차권을 받아 가세요/Please take your tickets, no 메뉴 anywhere), kt(key, locale, domain='food'), languageName(). menu.ts: formatWon(n, locale) 4,900원 / ₩4,900, formatFrom (5,500원부터 / from ₩5,500), lowestPrice(item) (tile shows 'from' only when a passenger option is cheaper than variants[0]), sheetSteps(..., domain) for the qty label. New KioskImage: photos cover, SVG pictograms contain on --k-primary-tint (unoptimized). Tiles: subtitle line, kcal only when not null; K4 shows signed deltas (−5,500원), add button = vocabularyOf(kiosk).add; cart bar aria-label = vocabulary.cart; review hides the dine row without dineOptions. Data: optional hero (malo /menu/hero.jpg; rail public/kiosks/airport_rail/hero.svg plane+skyline+train), optional theme.panel → --k-panel replacing hard-coded #F3EEE4 in kiosk components (rail #E4EBF4, default cream so MALO unchanged, I-110); malo locales [ko,en]. Tests: screen (no dine), menu (price per locale, lowestPrice, ticket steps), i18n/kiosk.test.ts (ko+en, no Hangul in en, ticket never says menu), catalog (hero path, panel contrast); e2e/kiosk-rail.spec.ts (rail touch flow 22,720원 to reference number; MALO English set to English review; XFF 192.0.2.24); kiosk.qa.spec.ts adds rail K1/K3/K4 passenger/K6 and MALO K1/K3 English (XFF 192.0.2.25), 0 H. Docs: I-019 fixed, I-109 (age range wraps at en dash, open), I-110; ARCHITECTURE schema, PRD Languages, USER_JOURNEY J2, UX, UI_GUIDE. lint, build, 627 unit, e2e 9 passed/5 skipped, qa:ui 18 passed; evidence/*.json restored (I-099).
